title: Restricted TCS7+DCS2 Single-Node SSDI Production Candidate Contract

allowed: F-PM04 tests, gate, workflow and integration evidence

selected_profile.rate: positive cm/day with positive interpolated depth and duration <= 1 day
selected_profile.table_policy: 2..7 finite strictly increasing DVS knots; below-first clamp; full seven-knot above-last clamp; partial-table above-last fail closed

api_design.hydraulic_input: process_hydraulic_view_t from the qualified F-SI17/F-MR07 interface
api_design.diagnostics_type: existing irrigation_diagnostics_t with fail-closed invalid-parameter/hydraulic statuses

parameter_data: TCS7 explicit DVS/head knots and actual knot count
DCS2 explicit DVS/depth_cm knots and actual knot count

selection_semantics.fixed_event_precedence: new scheduled start forbidden when fixed_event_already_selected is true

persistent_state.fixed_active_state: origin FIXED plus existing fixed event index/start/end
persistent_state.scheduled_active_state: origin SCHEDULED, active_event_index == 0, existing start/end; next_fixed_event_index remains unchanged
persistent_state.reason: rate and topology are immutable parameters; stored event end is sufficient for continuation

equation_identity.full_event_mass: external_inflow_amount summed over accepted event intervals = depth_cm

transaction_and_time.cross_event_end: IRRIGATION_SPLIT_REQUIRED with candidate identical to committed and no source applied

minimum_candidate_tests: fixed-event F-PM03 regression on modified module
selection_opportunity false cannot start even below threshold
AFGEN below-first, interior, exact knot and full-table above-last
positive DCS2 depth and duration identity
single-node SSDI source and full-event mass identity
completion followed by no-selection interval does not retrigger
future explicit selection opportunity may retrigger if physical condition still qualifies
